subject.name: Software Engineering with Agile Methodology
subject.title: AD-403 - Software Engineering with Agile Methodology

modules.title: Introduction to Software Engineering
topics: SDLC Models: Waterfall, V-Model, Prototype Model, Incremental, Evolutionary, RAD, Spiral
Project Planning, Metrics for Project Size Estimation, Project Estimation Techniques
Requirements Gathering and Analysis, Software Requirements Specification (SRS)
Software Process Models, Evolutionary Process Models and Agile processes
Software Process customization and improvement, CMM
Analysis Modeling for Function-oriented and Object-oriented software development

modules.title: Software Design, Analysis and Testing
topics: Architectural Design, Architectural Views and Styles
Function oriented Design, SA/SD Component Based Design
Software Static and Dynamic analysis, Code inspections
Software Testing Fundamentals, Software Test Process
Testing Levels, Test Criteria, Test Case Design, Test Oracles
Test Techniques, Testing Frameworks, Test Plan, Test Metrics, Testing Tools

modules.title: Software Maintenance & Software Project Measurement
topics: Software Change Management, Version Control, Change control and Reporting
Program Comprehension Techniques, Re-engineering, Reverse Engineering, Tool Support
Project and Process Planning, Resources Allocations
Software efforts, Schedule, and Cost estimations

modules.title: Fundamentals of Agile Methodology
topics: Introduction to Agile software development methodology
Agile v/s Traditional software development (Waterfall model)
Agile Manifesto: Principles, Benefits and Challenges of Agile
Agile Values, Agile Model, Phases of Agile Model

modules.title: Software Development using Agile Methodology
topics: User Stories: The currency of agile development
Characteristics of good user stories, Generating User Stories
Applying an Agile Mindset to a Project
Agile Frameworks: Scrum, Kanban, Crystal, XP, ASD, DSDM
